title: Player Wedged and Permanently Trapped in Ceiling Gap (Tile 55, 8)
explanation: At frame 462 (t=7.70s), entering the narrow gap at coordinates (4365.01, 633.12) caused the player to become completely immobile. Despite over 40 subsequent directional and jump inputs across frames 462 to 990 (nearly 9 seconds), player displacement remained 0.0px.
